title: 해양경찰위원회 규정 / queue:ARTICLE:7:0:00007:part:1/1
full_text: Article 7 (Allowances, etc.) Allowances, travel expenses, and other necessary expenses may be paid, within the budget, to relevant public officials or experts who attend a meeting of the Committee pursuant to Article 9 (1) of the Act: Provided, That such payments shall not be made to public officials who attend a meeting in direct connection with their official duties.
